summary.short: Software Engineer who builds secure web and mobile products end to end, from React and React Native interfaces to Fastify APIs, payments and AI features, and who also automates how they ship.
summary.long: Computer Engineer (ESPRIT, 2026) with hands-on experience building secure web and mobile applications with React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js and Fastify. Experienced in RESTful API design, multi-provider payment integrations (Tap, Tamara, Tabby, Apple Pay via Tap) and secure transaction workflows with webhooks and idempotency. Works with MongoDB, microservices and AI-powered features (Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Whisper, Groq, FastAPI services). Distinctive edge: also containerizes, wires CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), adds quality gates (SonarQube) and monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana) so features reach production reliably.
